messages:
ana: Quick watercooler poll  your 3-track capsule to get you through any mood. drop tracks + one media pairing if you want. i'll go.
mike: 1) Phoenix - Lisztomania 2) Burial - Archangel 3) Beyonce - Sandcastles. Pair: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle for late, odd afternoons.
sarah: Mine: 1) Fleet Foxes - Blue Ridge Mountains 2) LCD Soundsystem - New York, I Love You But You're Bringing Me Down 3) Janelle Mone1e - Make Me Feel. Pair: Fleabag S1.
julia: three is cruel but: 1) M83 - Wait 2) Portishead - Roads 3) Chairlift - Bruises. :heart:
kevin: synthwave set: 1) Kavinsky - Nightcall 2) Chromatics - Shadow 3) Perturbator - Future Club. Movie pair: Drive. :sunglasses:
ben: cozy indie: 1) Sufjan Stevens - Should Have Known Better 2) Angel Olsen - Windows 3) Radiohead - Sail to the Moon. Book pair: Norwegian Wood.
nana: (lol typo earlier, meant ana) wildcard: A-ha - Take On Me for ridiculous joy. :joy:
mike: adding Sandcastles to commute playlist rn :heart:
sarah: PSA: i auto-made a playlist from the thread: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/xyz789 (bot created).
ben: @mike wins my vote for most versatile capsule :1st_place_medal: 
kevin: anyone have a "monday debugging" 3-track capsule? i need focus + calm.
nana: @kevin i'll drop one after lunch. also office note: kitchen spider plant is drooping, pls water if you're in the office today :seedling:
julia: i'll take care of it tomorrow morning :ok_hand:
music-bot: Playlist "thread-3-track-capsules-2765432109" created (21 tracks).
nana: thanks folks, this was fun. if you want picks added to the office mix, paste them here and i'll queue them. :coffee:
